title: Chon-Ji

symbol.name: Chon-Ji
symbol.meaning: Heaven and earth · ITF pattern 1 of 24

note.p: Chon-Ji means heaven and earth: the creation of the world, so it is the first pattern a beginner learns. It has two halves, one for heaven and one for earth, both on a cross. You start where the lines meet facing D. The first half is low blocks and punches in walking stance to B, A, D and C; the second is inner forearm blocks in L-stance and punches, to A, B, C and D, ending with a step forward and two steps back.

footer: Move numbers follow the ITF Encyclopedia count (19 movements, one technique each). Directions use the ITF letters: you start facing D, B is on your left, A on your right and C behind. Finish by bringing the left foot back to parallel ready stance.

moves.desc: Stand at the centre of the cross facing D in parallel ready stance: feet parallel and one shoulder-width apart, fists in front of the belt.
Turn left: move the left foot to B into a left walking stance. Left forearm low block.
Step the right foot forward toward B into a right walking stance. Right middle punch.
Turn clockwise: move the right foot to A into a right walking stance facing A. Right forearm low block.
Step the left foot forward toward A into a left walking stance. Left middle punch.
Turn left: move the left foot to D into a left walking stance facing D. Left forearm low block.
Step the right foot forward toward D into a right walking stance. Right middle punch.
Turn clockwise: move the right foot to C into a right walking stance facing C. Right forearm low block.
Step the left foot forward toward C into a left walking stance. Left middle punch.
Turn left: move the left foot to A into a right L-stance facing A (left foot forward, weight on the right leg). Left inner forearm middle side block.
Step the right foot forward toward A into a right walking stance. Right middle punch.
Turn clockwise: move the right foot to B into a left L-stance facing B (right foot forward, weight on the left leg). Right inner forearm middle side block.
Step the left foot forward toward B into a left walking stance. Left middle punch.
Turn left: move the left foot to C into a right L-stance facing C (left foot forward, weight on the right leg). Left inner forearm middle side block.
Step the right foot forward toward C into a right walking stance. Right middle punch.
Turn clockwise: move the right foot to D into a left L-stance facing D (right foot forward, weight on the left leg). Right inner forearm middle side block.
Step the left foot forward toward D into a left walking stance. Left middle punch.
Step the right foot forward toward D into a right walking stance. Right middle punch, with a kihap.
Step the right foot back toward C into a left walking stance, still facing D. Left middle punch.
Step the left foot back toward C into a right walking stance, still facing D. Right middle punch.
